annotations.title: What is new on the account

description: Everything that happened on the account since a given moment: an order was received, is ready, or failed and why, or the email address was confirmed. It carries what our emails say, so the user can follow an order without watching an inbox. The result includes a cursor, and a call that gives it back as since starts where this one ended. Without since it covers the last 24 hours. Each update has an id that never changes, so the same update can be recognised if it comes back on two consecutive calls.

api_key.description: Barevalue API key (bv_sk_...), as returned by barevalue_register. Not needed when the connection already sends an Authorization: Bearer header.

since.description: The cursor returned by the previous call, or an ISO 8601 date and time
